Patriot Viper Steel DDR4 8GB 3200MHz CL16 Desktop Gaming RAM

Boost your desktop computer's multi-application tracking and responsiveness with the highly reliable Patriot Viper Steel DDR4 8GB 3200MHz CL16 gaming memory module. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance PC hardware component peripheral is masterfully engineered for mainstream PC gamers, budget build enthusiasts, and office multitasking users across Egypt who require ultimate system stability, optimized memory bandwidth translation, and seamless everyday operation. Manufactured with a custom-designed heavy-duty aluminum shield framework, this RAM module keeps your layout operating at peak thermal efficiency.

The Patriot Viper Steel DDR4 module delivers a high speed frequency profile of 3200MHz with a tight low-latency timing configuration of CL16-20-20-40, maximizing internal processing output layout channels. It offers complete plug-and-play compatibility with the latest Intel and AMD motherboard chipsets, making hardware setup quick and effortless. Equipped with full Intel XMP 2.0 overclocking support, users can easily unlock maximum frequency profiles directly from the system BIOS interface safely. Finished in a premium sleek Gunmetal Grey aesthetic styling treatment, it seamlessly matches any modern gaming or workspace interior build structure.
